run_generate_overlap_list: run the script to generate an overlap-30-full.txt file from scannet pair overlap data
run_filter_overlap_pairs: run the script to filter point cloud pairs with overlap greater than or equal to 0.3
run_scannet_pair_processing: run the script with a target directory to process all overlap.txt files in pcd subdirectories
review_main_function: review the main function that aggregates and filters overlap data from multiple scannet scenes
summarize_generate_list_script: summarize the script that collects point cloud pairs above a 0.3 overlap threshold into a single file
